address: 3F, Sandi Union Center, Zhenwu Road, Taijiang, Fuzhou, China Mainland
bio: Opened in 2020 as the premium version of a longstanding Fuzhou institution, Jing Li targets an upmarket business clientele. Burgundy seats and details grace the elegant wood-rich interior. On the menu, local Minnan classics are creatively melded with other cuisines. The dishes made with red yeast rice wine lees, such as the deep-fried wine lees-marinated eel, and longevity noodles with pork trotter braised in wine lees, are particular standouts....
